subject: Trial technical handoff and success criteria - next steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@fintrax.com>, Elena Morales <elena@fintrax.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial technical handoff and success criteria - next steps

Thanks for the call earlier — good alignment from my side. Quick recap plus concrete next steps so we have an actionable handoff into the technical trial phase. Please confirm or correct any items below.

High-level objective:
- Run a 3-week technical trial to validate end-to-end inference for Fintrax reconciliation workflows (document classification + entity extraction) and measure latency, accuracy, and cost per 1k predictions.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Functional: SDK-integrated inference pipeline can process sample batch (10k pages) with >=95% throughput availability in your staging environment.
- Latency: p95 generation latency < 450ms for single-document calls (streaming off for batch jobs, see notes).
- Quality: extraction F1 >= 0.86 on the agreed evaluation set (we'll share label-mapping).
- Cost: sustained per-token cost within the committed envelope (see attachment: fintrax_poc_scope.pdf).

Technical scope and handoff items:
1) API/SDK: Redwood SDK (v1.4.0) integration recommended for streaming + KV cache. We'll provide a short snippet for your stack (attached).
2) Routes: primary route will be /v1/inference/stream for low-latency calls and /v1/inference/batch for bulk. Ben will own route configs.
3) Auth & networking: we'll support token-based auth for the trial. If you need VPC peering for staging, flag it now — lead time is ~5 business days.
4) Tool calling: we support function/tool calling for structured extraction; agree to enable on canary model only during the trial.
5) Metrics & eval: we'll instrument model telemetry and provide a dashboard — share any internal metrics you must capture.

Timeline (draft):
- Wed 10/20: tech handoff call (30m) — Ben + Marissa + your engineering lead
- Tue 10/26: SDK integration complete (dev deploy)
- Tue 11/02: Full trial run starts (3 weeks)
- Tue 11/23: Acceptance review and results

Owners:
- Redwood technical owner: Ben Carter (API routes, streaming config)
- Redwood product owner: Marissa Cole (success criteria, evals)
- Customer technical lead: Sam Park

Attachments:
- fintrax_poc_scope.pdf (scope and acceptance checklist)
- sdk-integration-snippet.txt (small code excerpt for Node + streaming)

Immediate asks for Fintrax:
- Confirm you accept the proposed success criteria and timeline by EOD Wed 10/19.
- Provide a staging endpoint (hostname + ingress details) or confirm you want Redwood-hosted sandbox.
- Identify your security contact for the SOC2 / questionnaire exchange.

Thanks — I'll schedule the 10/20 handoff once I have confirmation.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks — looping in the technical details you'll need. Ben and I paired on an integration checklist; attaching the minimal snippets and the routing matrix to this thread. Highlights: 

- SDK: use Redwood SDK v1.4.0 (Node/Python). Streaming example (Node):
  - const stream = client.stream({ model: 'rwd-embed-aug', route: '/v1/inference/stream' });
  - stream.on('delta', d => console.log(d));

- Batch: POST /v1/inference/batch with content-encoding: gzip for large uploads. We'll accept NDJSON and multipart with attachments.

- Tool calling: enable function calling on canary model (will surface structured JSON). We'll include a sample function signature for your extraction pipeline.

- PII redaction: we'll provide a small evaluation harness that runs redaction + extraction and reports masking recall/precision. Add this to the quality gate.

- Observability: please expose a prometheus scrape endpoint or provide a basic metrics export (request id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out) so our dashboards can annotate runs.

Attachments in Drive: sdk-integration-snippet.txt (attached to this message), fintrax_poc_scope.pdf (acceptance checklist).

Next steps we will take immediately:
1) Ben will drop SDK example in Drive and post a short PR with sample config (expected by EOD today).
2) Jonas will schedule the 10/20 handoff (09:30 PT).
3) Elena to share SOC2 contact and questionnaire link to the Drive folder once we have the security contact.

If you prefer Redwood-hosted sandbox for the first 48 hours to remove network setup friction, say the word and we can provision it.

—Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
